outcome: pain severity score at 6th, 12th, and 24th hours
cohort: Sixty-two parturients scheduled for elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia at Debre Tabor General Hospital.
finding: Transversus Abdominis Plane block (TAP) reduced postoperative tramadol and diclofenac consumption, increased time to first analgesic request, and reduced pain severity scores at 6, 12, and 24 hours compared to Wound site Infiltration (WI).
